target_scope: EUR_JPY and GBP_JPY; trigger thesis preserved with GBP_JPY threshold relaxed to 1.0
runner: app.run_daytrade_backtest(backtest_mode=True; production daytrade path; strategy-only compute patch)

lock_spec.bt_evidence_threshold: if proposed N < 20 => INSUFFICIENT_BT_EVIDENCE, skip catastrophic, recommend shadow
lock_spec.catastrophic_check: pnl_sign_preserved only: baseline PnL > 0 and proposed PnL < 0 rejects

shadow_registration_note: base vsg_jpy_reversal is already in DaytradeEngine.SHADOW_ALWAYS_STRATEGIES; V2 behavior is default-off unless VSG_JPY_REVERSAL_REDESIGN_V2=1. No V2 shadow-promote setting is applied when the overall verdict is REJECT.
shadow_accumulation_target: 60-90 days or N>=30 after shadow start

self_review.catastrophic_only: PASS: verdict uses only pnl_sign_preserved when proposed N>=20; PF/Wilson/N are warn-only.
self_review.insufficient_bt_evidence: PASS: proposed N<20 becomes INSUFFICIENT_BT_EVIDENCE and recommends shadow.
self_review.production_live_safety: PASS: V2 trigger/geometry/time-exit are default-off unless VSG_JPY_REVERSAL_REDESIGN_V2=1; BT cache and SL/TP preserve are flag-aware.
self_review.post_hoc_adjustment: PASS: only pre-registered V2 exit geometry plus pair threshold/hold candidates from the audit are evaluated.
self_review.bt_source_guard: PASS: BT_REQUIRE_MASSIVE_CACHE=1 requires MASSIVE parquet and prevents Yahoo fallback for this report.
